sources.title: Benin launches "JaimeMaLangue" project to bring local languages into AI
sources.snippet: Project supports Benin's national AI and big data strategy adopted in 2023 The Beninese government officially launched the "JaimeMaLangue" project on November 10 in Cotonou, an innovative initiative designed to integrate local languages into the artificial intelligence ecosystem.

sources.title: Benin launches "LoveMyLanguage" AI project - APAnews
sources.snippet: Benin has officially launched the "JaimeMaLangue" (LoveMyLanguage) project in Cotonou. This pioneering initiative, a joint effort between the Information Systems and Digital Technology Agency (ASIN) and the IIDiA Institute, aims to integrate artificial intelligence (AI) into the digital world to promote and preserve local languages.
